name: AI Raphael
tagline: Generate and edit images with plain-language prompts
description: AI Raphael (Raphael AI at airaphael.org) is a web-based AI image generator and photo editor. Type what you want, or upload a photo and describe the change in plain language. It keeps faces and characters consistent across edits, preserves the rest of the scene, and can blend several images into one. Pick 1:1, 16:9, 4:5 or 9:16 and get instant variations. A prompt library helps you start. Extra tools cover background removal, upscaling, old photo restoration and image-to-prompt, plus anime, tattoo, coloring-page, logo and hairstyle generators. It can also turn text or images into 4–30 second videos up to 1080p. It uses models such as Nano Banana Pro and GPT Image. New users get 10 free credits; paid packs start at $9.9.
